service.method: SELECT MODULE AS TREE_ID , MODULE , PARENT AS TREE_PARENT_ID , PARENT , DESCRIPTION AS TREE_VALUE , DESCRIPTION , `OPTIONS` , SORT , `TYPE` , NODE , REMARK , ALIAS , DEFAULT_OPTION_VALUE FROM SBMMA ORDER BY PARENT, SORT

WITH RECURSIVE LINKED AS ( SELECT MODULE ,CAST(PARENT AS CHAR) AS TREE_PARENT_ID ,PARENT ,COMBO ,CAST(CONCAT(PARENT , '_' , CAST(SORT AS CHAR)) AS CHAR) AS TREE_ID ,SBMMA.DESCRIPTION ,SBMMA.SORT ,SBMMA.NODE ,SBMMA.`TYPE` ,SBMMA.`OPTIONS` ,SBMMA.ALIAS FROM SBMMA WHERE PARENT = '*' UNION ALL SELECT BMMA.MODULE ,CAST(L.TREE_ID AS CHAR) ,BMMA.PARENT ,BMMA.COMBO ,CAST(CONCAT(L.TREE_ID , '_' , CAST(BMMA.SORT AS CHAR)) AS CHAR) ,BMMA.DESCRIPTION ,BMMA.SORT ,BMMA.NODE ,BMMA.`TYPE` ,BMMA.`OPTIONS` ,BMMA.ALIAS FROM SBMMA BMMA JOIN LINKED L ON L.MODULE = BMMA.PARENT ) SELECT L.TREE_ID AS TREE_ID ,L.TREE_PARENT_ID AS TREE_PARENT_ID ,LANG.CONTENTS AS TREE_VALUE ,L.MODULE ,L.PARENT ,L.COMBO ,LANG.CONTENTS AS MODULE_NAME ,LANG2.CONTENTS AS DESCRIPTION ,CASE WHEN #DB_OWNER#NVL(CMAM.MODULE, '_NOT_SELECTED_') = '_NOT_SELECTED_' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS USE_FLAG ,CMAM.OPTION FROM LINKED L JOIN SLANG LANG ON LANG.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE' AND LANG.LANGUAGE = 'KO' AND LANG.CODE = L.MODULE LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG LANG2 ON LANG2.SCREEN_ID = 'BUSINESS_MODULE_DES' AND LANG2.LANGUAGE = 'KO' AND LANG2.CODE = L.MODULE LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMAM CMAM ON CMAM.MODULE = L.MODULE ORDER BY TREE_ID
SELECT MODULE ,OPTIONS FROM SCMAM WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}
